subtitle: Event bus between CRM, ERP and EDS: who delivers events to whom, what is stuck and what to retry.

sources.unavailable: {{domain}} is not responding — the journal is incomplete.
sources.forbidden: {{domain}} denied access to its journal: permissions have not reached it yet or were revoked.
sources.not_applicable: You have no access to {{domain}} — its journal is not shown.

subscribers.title: {{domain}} sends to
subscribers.caption: {{domain}} subscribers: state, queue and undelivered
subscribers.empty: {{domain}} has no subscribers yet — its events are not delivered to anyone.

deliveries.caption: Event deliveries to subscribers
deliveries.dlqHint: Deliveries the bus no longer retries by itself: the subscriber refused (404, 410, 422) or all 7 attempts failed. Fix the cause and retry — one by one or all of a subscriber on the “Subscribers” tab.

empty.title: No deliveries found
empty.text: Events of CRM, ERP and EDS appear here per subscriber. Change the filters or the period.

dlqEmpty.title: Nothing undelivered
dlqEmpty.text: All events reached their subscribers or are still being retried on the bus schedule.

inboxView.caption: Received events whose processing failed
inboxView.hint: Events the domain received but could not apply: processing is retried automatically (30 s, 2 min, 10 min), then stays with an error. After the fix — “Retry processing”.

empty.title: No processing errors
empty.text: All received events of CRM, ERP and EDS are processed. If a handler fails, the event appears here.

panel.noBody: The event body is not shown in the journal: it may contain client data. Type, object and event ID are enough.
panel.notRetriable: Nothing to retry: the delivery has already gone or is being sent.
panel.inboxNotRetriable: Nothing to retry: the event is processed or still waits for an automatic retry.

consequence.now: The delivery is sent now, the attempt counter starts from zero.
consequence.probe: If the subscriber is paused, it gets a probe delivery right away.
consequence.safe: Retrying is safe: the receiver drops duplicates by event ID. The domain journal keeps who retried and when.
consequence.inboxNow: The event goes to processing in {{domain}} again.
consequence.inboxFix: If the cause was not fixed, the event comes back with the same error.
consequence.inboxSafe: Retrying is safe: handlers apply snapshots by change time. The domain journal keeps who retried and when.

panel.retried: Queued for retry. The journal refreshes in a few seconds.
panel.nothing: Nothing to retry: the record has gone, is in progress or does not exist.
panel.deadIntro: Publisher — {{domain}}. In the DLQ of subscriber {{subscriber}}: {{count}}.

deadConsequence.now: All DLQ deliveries of this subscriber ({{count}}) are sent now, attempts start from zero.
deadConsequence.fix: Fix the cause first: receiver address, pair secret or the receiver itself — otherwise the deliveries return to the DLQ.
deadConsequence.probe: If the subscriber is paused, it gets a probe delivery right away.
deadConsequence.safe: Retrying is safe: the receiver drops duplicates by event ID. The {{domain}} journal keeps who retried and when.

panel.deadNone: The subscriber has nothing undelivered anymore.

loadError.title: Could not load the journal
loadError.text: The journal is built from CRM, ERP and EDS. Retry; if the error stays, check Settings · Connections.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Not enough rights: the integration log is for the administrator.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The domain is not responding. Try again later.
errors.DEFAULT: The action failed. Please try again.
